about: The Claude request corpus for M12 (EDITOR_PLAN §9 plus compound, impossible, conflicting, question and safety cases). Each request has its map setup, goals with intent-check expectations, feasibility, what the report must say, pass criteria, and a reference solution run by bin/reference.ts through MapSession with the real validators.
